purpose: Generate protagonist magnet from current observable choices rather than biography, trauma explanation, symbolic origin or complete psychological diagnosis.
requirements: At least three observable current choices across different relationships/scenes.
At least one natural exception that does not fully obey the apparent pattern but still feels like the same person.
One long-term desire may be stated, but it may not be used as a causal explanation for every behavior.
Long-horizon reader desire must come from what this person may choose next and whether they change, not from repeated proof of a diagnosis.

mandatory_attacks.REMOVE_BIOGRAPHY: Card must remain fully usable because it contains no required origin story.
mandatory_attacks.SWAP_PROTAGONIST: If another generally competent/strong/avoidant protagonist can inherit the same behavioral texture with little loss, FAIL.
mandatory_attacks.HUMAN_MESSINESS: At least one already-visible exception/inconsistency must remain unresolved rather than explained away.
mandatory_attacks.FIFTY_CHAPTER_REPETITION: Behavioral pleasure must branch into meaningfully different choices and costs across 50 chapters.
